channel.title: The Valdosta Daily Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Valdosta Daily Times (valdostadailytimes.com)

item.title: Funding the Future brings music & financial literacy to Georgia schools this spring
item.description: Funding the Future is bringing music, inspiration, and real-world money smarts to high schools across the state this spring.

item.title: SGMC Orthopedics celebrates new, expanded location with ribbon cutting
item.description: The Valdosta-Lowndes County Chamber of Commerce recently celebrated the relocation of SGMC Orthopedics with a ribbon cutting ceremony at its new, expanded facility located at 2310 N. Patterson St., Suite B, in Valdosta.

item.title: SGMC Health accepting applications for Volunteen Summer Program
item.description: For high school students curious about healthcare, spending a summer at SGMC Health can be a first step toward a future career.

item.title: Candidates qualify for county, school board seats
item.description: Georgia’s 2026 midterm election qualification period ended Friday, and the list for who qualifies for the ballot has been updated.

item.title: Lowndes County 4-Hers win district honors
item.description: Four Lowndes County 4-H’ers returned home from the Southwest District Project Achievement competition with honors in their project areas.

item.title: City of Valdosta receives $98,250 grant to expand waterway debris interceptor program
item.description: The City of Valdosta has received $98,250 in grant funding through the Georgia Rivers Grant Program to support continued efforts to improve local waterways and reduce debris in area streams.

item.title: South Georgia nonprofit leaders to gather for annual conference on March 12
item.description: The South Georgia Nonprofit Network (SGNN) will host its annual Connect • Learn • Lead Conference on Thursday, March 12, at Second Harvest of South Georgia in Valdosta.

item.title: Lowndes County explains data center prospects
item.description: The Lowndes County government released a statement Monday afternoon in connection with discussions of a data center proposed for Lowndes County.

item.title: Taxes, electricity costs, and elections emerge as top topics for final weeks of Georgia General Assembly
item.description: Georgia legislators are preparing for fierce debates on tax cuts, data centers, and voting during the final sprint of lawmaking this year.

item.title: Valdosta Main Street and Central Valdosta Development Authority earn renewal of Georgia Main Street accreditation
item.description: The Valdosta Main Street Program and the Central Valdosta Development Authority (CVDA) have once again earned accreditation from Georgia Main Street.
